title: Fields
comment: A picture is a function of x and y. `paint(x)` is a gradient, left to right;
`paint(y)`, top to bottom; x through a sine is stripes; mix in y and they
bend; change the palette and the same function comes out in colour. Each
result is painted by the very expression on screen, inside its frame.

sections.name: the hook: the mark in red, the episode
sections.label: fields
sections.say: A picture is a function of x and y.
stage: let hk1 = text("02  ·  fields", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: x: a gradient from left to right
sections.label: x
sections.say: x goes from zero on the left to one on the right.
stage: let xf = max(k2_code, max(f2 * RULE, g2 * GREY))

sections.name: y: a gradient from top to bottom
sections.label: y
sections.say: y goes from the top to the bottom.
stage: let yf = max(k3_code, max(f3 * RULE, g3 * GREY))

sections.name: a function: x through a sine, stripes
sections.label: a function
sections.say: Put x through a sine, and you get stripes.
stage: let sinf = max(k4_code, f4 * RULE)

sections.name: x and y: the stripes bend
sections.label: x and y
sections.say: Mix in y, and the stripes bend. Any function is a picture.
stage: let bendf = max(k5_code, f5 * RULE)

sections.name: the palette: the same function, in colour
sections.label: the palette
sections.say: Change the palette: the same function, in colour.
stage: let g6 = text("ember", x: 0.5, y: 1.12, size: 0.028, font: "mono") * (T >= 41.3)
let palf = max(k6_code, max(f6 * RULE, g6 * GREY))

sections.name: the end: the whole program, the name, where to try it, what comes next
sections.say: Next week: shapes. Circles, rings, squares. Merge them, mask them.
stage: let nsize = 0.2
let nadv = 0.5172 * nsize
let nx0e = 0.5 - 2.5 * nadv
let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.56, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 48.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.56) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 48.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  02  ·  fields", x: 0.5, y: 0.70, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 49.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 49.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  03  ·  shapes", x: 0.5, y: 0.94, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l7.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 51.0)
let endf = max(k7_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))
